{{Top|leg}}
'''Yokel Group''' was the name given to the members of [[Wraith Squadron]] who posed as [[Agamar/Legends|Agamarian]] brothers for their inspection upon entrance to [[Storinal]].

The group consisted of [[Garik Loran]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and [[Myn Donos]], playing the parts of [[Garik Loran|Dod]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Fod]], and [[Myn Donos|Lod Nobrin]] respectively. The members of Yokel Group joined [[Joyride Group]] for their theft of two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and subsequent extraction.
